name: Space Goblin Boomtechie
body:
SPACE GOBLIN BOOMTECHIE
CR 1/2

XP 200
Goblin (space goblin*) mechanic (explosives expert) 1
NE Small humanoid (goblinoid)
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+1 size, +3 Dex, +1 armor)
hp 10 (1d8+1+1)
Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee dogslicer +3 (1d4 S, 19–20/×2, fragile)
Ranged bomb +3 touch (1d6+3 fire, 20-ft. range incr., splash DC 13) or junklaser +3 touch (1d6 fire, 40-ft. range incr., semi-automatic)
Special Attacks bombs (4/day)

STATISTICS

Str 10 (+0), Dex 17 (+3), Con 13 (+1), Int 16 (+3), Wis 12 (+1), Cha 6 (–2)
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 13
Feats Technologist (B), Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb 4, Craft (mechanical) 7, Disable Device 9 (10 vs. technological items), Knowledge (engineering) 7 (8 vs. technological items and creatures), Perception 5, Stealth 10, Survival 4; Species Modifiers +2 Disable Device, +2 Stealth, +2 Survival
Languages Common, Goblin
SQ bypass, custom rig, tinker

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Tinker (Ex)

You clever and are skilled at getting the most out of broken equipment.

As a move action, you can remove the penalties associated with the broken condition from a single piece of equipment until the start of your next turn. The item then becomes unusable for 10 minutes, and retains the broken condition after that until it is fixed.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (space)
Organization gang (4–12) or tribe (13+ plus 13+ noncombatants, 1 advanced space goblin of CR 2–3, and 5–6 alien pets)
Treasure standard (stationwear, dogslicer, junklaser* with 1 battery [10 charges], other treasure)
